QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] The Song of the Bramble Harp
QuestInfo.0: As you wait for the Bramble Harp to restore itself, several angry Tree Spirits arrive.
QuestInfo.1:
The Rescued Tree Spirit arrives and saves you from its friends. The Bramble Harps restores itself, and begins to play.
Talk to the #rLost Tree Spirit#k in #b#m940200216##k for details.
QuestInfo.2: The Rescued Tree Spirit apologizes on behalf of its fellow spirits. But what's this about a stranger with an evil aura?

1.0: Thank you for saving me. I'm glad I was able to repay the favor.
1.1: You should know, uh, I would have saved you even if the harp wasn't restored. You have a good heart. I'm sure the others can see that by now.

yes.0: I know the other Tree Spirits seem angry... But inside they're just scared and sad.
yes.1: We all feel guilty... It's our duty to protect the trees of this forest. We tried to help the Spirit Tree...
yes.2: But all of our efforts ended in failure... Hope turned into helplessness.
yes.3: We started to feel like we were the ones hurting the Spirit Tree, and so we gave up and lashed out at others.
yes.4: I don't expect you to forgive how my fellow spirits treated you...\r\nI just wanted to say I'm sorry on their behalf.
yes.5: I know you're not working with that stranger with the terrible aura, the one who brought this corruption into our forest.

default.0: #b(The lost spirit is wriggling anxiously. You should see what it has to say.)#k
